visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black baseball cap with a white logo and a black t-shirt sits in the driver's seat of a car. He displays his left arm, which is covered from shoulder to wrist in a bright, colorful tattoo sleeve featuring Hello Kitty characters and pink flowers. The lighting is soft and neutral within the car interior. (2) The scene shifts outdoors to a paved walkway lined with low concrete walls and parked cars. A small boy in a white sweater and dark pants runs toward the camera in natural daylight. The man's tattooed arm enters the frame, reaching toward the child. (3) Back inside the car, the boy sits in the rear passenger seat, holding a white and blue plush unicorn. He looks at the camera with a playful, smiling expression while the man's arm remains visible in the foreground. (4) A young girl in a blue fuzzy sweater appears in the back seat next to the boy. She looks at the man's tattooed arm with a skeptical and unimpressed facial expression. (5) A extreme close-up focuses on the arm tattoo, highlighting the cartoon bear and Hello Kitty illustrations among floral patterns. The camera then cuts back to the man and the children reacting to each other.
